title: AutoServerRestart
description:
This plugins allow your server restart itself specific time, example theres no playing in your server after 5mins with no player active it would restart automatically

This was great for non 24/7 free hosting that has time limit TY
body:
**Auto Restart For Minecraft Server, This is allow your Minecraft Server Restart Itself Its good for Non 24/7 Free hosting that has Limit Time 

commands : /res, /res time (5) /res reload

this is only beta, if you encounter bugs, dont worry i will fix it a man will keep em promise well, bye**
